subject: Order Form SLA: credit handback & response-time compromise
messages:
From: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@healco.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rosa Martinez <rosa.martinez@healco.com>
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Initial redlines to SLA and credits (Order Form)

Sofia — thanks for the quick demo last week. Attached are the HealCo legal redlines on the Order Form and SLA we discussed (see HealCo_SLA_redlines_20270529.pdf). High level asks: 1) move uptime target to 99.99% (we understand typical is 99.9%) with monthly service credits scaled accordingly; 2) limit Redwood maintenance windows to two scheduled events/month and require 72-hour notice for any non-emergency maintenance; 3) faster severity-1 response (30 minutes) from current proposal; 4) a cap on aggregate credits to 50% of monthly invoice is OK, but HealCo would prefer automatic offset (credit handback as applied invoice discount) vs. provider-side one-time credit.

We don't expect you to accept all redlines, but we need a path to sign. Can you route to legal/ops and come back with prioritized counterpoints?

Thanks,
Jamie
Head of IT Procurement | HealCo
[Attachment: HealCo_SLA_redlines_20270529.pdf (pdf)]
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@healco.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial redlines to SLA and credits (Order Form)

Jamie — appreciate the clear list. Looping in Dev (platform ops) and Laura (legal) to map out which items are negotiable and which need alternate language. Quick notes up front: 1) 99.99% is a material step-up — can we propose a tiered uptime with higher credits but limited to specific critical routes? 2) Maintenance notice: 72 hours for non-emergency is reasonable; we normally do 48 hours, so we'll take that back. 3) Severity-1 response: 30 min is aggressive; our standard S1 ack is 15 minutes and initial engineering response within 2 hours unless you want a committed follow-the-sun rotation (adds cost). 4) Credit-handback as automatic invoice discount is doable but needs finance/legal sign-off on accounting treatment.

We'll review the redline PDF and send a consolidated counterproposal by EOD Wed.

—Sofia
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 May 2027 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial redlines to SLA and credits (Order Form)

Sofia/Team — reviewed HealCo's redlines. Technical constraints and proposed alternate language below:

- Uptime: 99.99% at the tenant level for all routes is risky without dedicated capacity. Suggest: 99.9% across standard endpoints; optional 99.99% for pinned Dedicated pools (add-on priced). Proposed wording: "Provider will offer an elevated uptime tier (99.99%) for dedicated capacity where Customer commits to reserved capacity per Order Form."

- Maintenance: we can accept two scheduled maintenance events/month for production if each is <= 2 hours and we provide 72-hour notification for planned maintenance. Emergency maintenance carve-out: immediate patching with post-facto notice and root-cause within 48 hours. Proposed clause text attached (see redlined_orderform_v3.docx).

- S1 Response: we do 15-min ack via pager and 2-hr eng response to begin remediation. For 30-min full remediation commitment, need 24x7 dedicated on-call with escalations (this is a priced SLA). Suggest offering Premium Support Add-on with S1 30-min remediation guarantee.

- Credits: cap at 50% monthly invoice is standard; HealCo's ask for invoice-applied offset ("handback") is operationally feasible. Finance prefers credits apply as invoice adjustments for the next billing cycle rather than cash refunds. Need legal to confirm language to avoid revenue recognition issues.

I'll mark up the Order Form and circle back.

—Dev
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redlined_orderform_v3.docx (docx)]
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@healco.com>, Rosa Martinez <rosa.martinez@healco.com>
Date: Wed, 02 June 2027 09:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial redlines to SLA and credits (Order Form)

Team / Jamie — attaching a clean counterproposal below and a few legal notes inline. High-level: we can accept the invoice-offset (credit handback) approach if the Order Form clarifies that credits are applied to subsequent invoices and that unused credits expire after 12 months. We cannot agree to unconditional 99.99% without dedicated capacity commitment; propose a two-tier offering in the Order Form (Standard + Dedicated Elevated Tier).

Legal highlights: 1) Maintenance: 72-hour notice for planned; emergency maintenance permitted with post-notice; define "emergency" narrowly. 2) Credits: cap at 50% monthly invoice; credits calculated pro rata by affected endpoints; credits applied as invoice adjustments within 30 days. 3) Response SLAs: preserve our right to suspend credits if the root cause is customer misconfiguration or force majeure.

Jamie — if you can confirm whether HealCo will consider a Dedicated pool for their most critical workloads (we'll price separately), I can get final redline language ready for signature.

—Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@healco.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rosa Martinez <rosa.martinez@healco.com>
Date: Wed, 02 June 2027 12:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Initial redlines to SLA and credits (Order Form)

Laura — thanks for the clear counterproposal. A few responses: 1) HealCo is open to a dedicated elevated tier for our payment and patient-facing inference endpoints — please send pricing and minimum commitment. 2) The invoice-offset approach is acceptable; we prefer credits to auto-apply to the next invoice and to have reporting in the Console showing how credits were calculated. 3) On S1: our procurement team will review the Premium Support add-on pricing; we may accept a paid premium for the 30-min remediation if the uplift is reasonable.

Can we schedule a short call Thursday to confirm pricing and final redline language? If you can send a marked Order Form with the two-tier option and the credit-handback language, we'll run it by finance.

Thanks,
Jamie
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Cole <jamie.cole@healco.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
